description: A regtest chain captured whole as the DRS-E2 replay pair. corpus.e2: every block 0..=tip_height with the FULL bytes of every listed transaction (shekyl-chain-replay fetch, RD-F15-verified). trace.e2: the passed-through facts per block and the daemon's logical-state digest at the tip (shekyl-e2-trace-export, one LMDB snapshot). Consumed by replay: shekyl-chain-ingest connects the chain against a real store, so the state the 4.I rules read is derived, not asserted. Regenerate with SHEKYL_CAPTURE_CHAIN_VECTORS=1, SHEKYLD_BIN, SHEKYL_CHAIN_REPLAY_BIN and SHEKYL_E2_TRACE_EXPORT_BIN set, running the named generator --ignored.
